mechanism_narrative: The current level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is a positive predictor of S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, and this relationship holds for all observed levels of FEDFUNDS, so that the signal always predicts positive returns regardless of the rate level.
failure_condition: The Rank IC of FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 20d SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) rises above 4.0% in a 3-month window, it signals a monetary tightening cycle that increases equity discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.0% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) rises above 200 and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) rises above 3.5%, it signals a high-inflation, high-rate environment that increases equity risk premiums, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC of the interaction between CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 20d SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, as indicated by strong GDP growth (GDPC1) and high housing starts (HOUST), the S&P 500 is overvalued and prone to negative returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 and HOUST indicate late-cycle expansion over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 5.0% in a 3-month window, it signals an economic slowdown that increases risk aversion, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The current level of residential sales (RSAFS) is a positive predictor of S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, and this relationship holds for all observed levels of RSAFS, so that the signal always predicts positive returns regardless of the sales level.
failure_condition: The Rank IC of RSAFS as a predictor of 20d SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 115 and housing starts (HOUST) rises above 2000, it signals a supply shock in manufacturing and strong demand in housing, which together indicate a robust economic expansion that produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC of the interaction between INDPRO and HOUST as a predictor of 60d SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In monetary tightening cycles, as indicated by a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and rising consumer price index (CPIAUCSL), the S&P 500 is expected to produce negative forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL are both rising over any 3-year rolling window.
